axes.label: How
axes.description: The primary lever of change — what kind of innovation is actually at work.

values.label: New vehicle
values.description: A new physical form factor: Citroën Ami, Microlino, Toyota FT-Me. The innovation is the object itself.

values.label: New propulsion
values.description: Electrification or repowering of an existing form: e-scooter, e-bike, retrofit kits. The shape is familiar; the drivetrain is not.

values.label: New usage model
values.description: Shared, free-floating, subscription, short-term rental. Lime, Voi, Swapfiets. The vehicle may be ordinary; the way it reaches users is the lever.

values.label: Regulatory push
values.description: The innovation IS the rule change: ZFE zones, speed limits, permit reform, new vehicle categories. Policy as product.

values.label: Infrastructure
values.description: Bike lanes, charging hubs, intermodal stations, parking reform. Built environment as the enabler.

values.label: Software / platform
values.description: Apps, fleet management, routing, data analytics. Fluctuo, MaaS aggregators, dispatch software.

axes.label: Why
axes.description: The primary driver — the problem or desire the innovation answers to.

values.label: Decarbonation
values.description: Reducing CO₂, meeting climate targets, electrifying transport.

values.label: Congestion
values.description: Fewer cars, less traffic, more efficient use of road space.

values.label: Cost
values.description: Cheaper than owning or operating a private car — for users, for cities, or for fleets.

values.label: Access
values.description: Usable without a full licence: age 14+, disabled users, people excluded from conventional cars.

values.label: Last mile
values.description: Bridging the gap between mass transit and the actual destination.

values.label: Fun / lifestyle
values.description: Desire and image, not utility. Buggy, Microlino, La Bagnole lean here.

values.label: Health
values.description: Active mobility — cycling, walking — as a public-health lever.

values.label: Logistics
values.description: Professional delivery, trades, services. Cargo bikes, microvans, last-mile fleets.

axes.label: Who
axes.description: The target user — whose mobility problem the innovation addresses.

values.label: Urban daily
values.description: City commuters, dense-urban residents using the system every day.

values.label: Periurban
values.description: Suburbs, mid-density towns, agglomérations — often underserved by transit.

values.label: Rural
values.description: Genuine countryside, low-density areas. La Bagnole sits here.

values.label: Youth
values.description: 14–18, pre-licence age. The L6e quadricycle category is built around them.

values.label: Senior / PMR
values.description: Older users and people with reduced mobility. Toyota APM angle.

values.label: Professional
values.description: Delivery riders, trades, mobile services — vehicles as work tools.

values.label: Tourist
values.description: Seasonal, short-trip use. Holiday rentals, resort fleets.

axes.label: Scope
axes.description: The type of actor behind the innovation.

values.label: Startup
values.description: Early-stage company: Kilow, early Lime, Dott at launch.

values.label: Scale-up
values.description: Post-Series B, operating at scale. Lime, Voi in their current form.

values.label: Legacy auto
values.description: Incumbent carmakers: Toyota, Stellantis, Renault, their mobility spin-offs.

values.label: Public / city
values.description: Municipal operators and contracts: Vélib', city-run bike share, public tenders.

values.label: NGO / advocacy
values.description: Industry bodies, advocacy groups, observatories. Mobilians, Observatoire national.

values.label: Research
values.description: Academic labs, think tanks, public-research mobility programs.

axes.label: Form factor
axes.description: The vehicle category — regulatory treatment differs sharply by category, so this matters.

values.label: EDPM
values.description: Engins de déplacement personnel motorisés: e-scooters, hoverboards, trottinettes électriques.

values.label: E-bike
values.description: Pedal-assist bicycles and speed pedelecs.

values.label: Cargo bike
values.description: Family cargo bikes and professional delivery cargo cycles.

values.label: Quadricycle L6e
values.description: Light quad, sans permis, capped at 45 km/h. Citroën Ami, Microlino.

values.label: Quadricycle L7e
values.description: Heavy quad, up to 80 km/h, B1 permit required. Fiat Topolino full-size variants.

values.label: Moped / scooter
values.description: Two-wheel motorized vehicles, thermal or electric.

values.label: Microvan
values.description: Cargo quads, last-mile delivery boxes, small electric utility vehicles.

axes.label: Status
axes.description: Where the innovation sits in its lifecycle.

values.label: Concept
values.description: Announced or shown but not yet in production. Toyota FT-Me, some Mobilize concepts.

values.label: Pilot
values.description: Small production run or limited deployment, testing the market. Early Kilow.

values.label: Active — growing
values.description: In market, expanding. Fiat Topolino, Voi in Paris.

values.label: Active — mature
values.description: Established, stable, no longer in rapid growth. Citroën Ami, Vélib'.

values.label: Struggling
values.description: Available but commercially weak or losing ground. Mobilize Duo, Microlino in volume terms.

values.label: Abandoned
values.description: Withdrawn from the market or discontinued. Bird in France, Renault Twizy.

axes.label: Geography
axes.description: Territorial fit — solutions don't transfer 1:1 between contexts.

values.label: Dense urban
values.description: Paris intramuros and equivalent high-density cores.

values.label: Mid-city
values.description: Lyon, Bordeaux, Rennes — medium-sized French cities.

values.label: Periurban
values.description: Agglomérations, communes rurbanisées, the band around mid- and large cities.

values.label: Rural
values.description: Genuine low-density countryside use.

values.label: Cross-border
values.description: EU-level plays: harmonized vehicle categories, cross-country operators, regulatory alignment.

axes.label: Business model
axes.description: How the innovation sustains itself economically.

values.label: Product sale
values.description: The user buys the vehicle outright.

values.label: Subscription
values.description: Monthly fee for ongoing access to a vehicle. Swapfiets model.

values.label: Pay per use
values.description: Per-minute or per-trip pricing. Lime, Voi, free-floating fleets.

values.label: B2B fleet
values.description: Sold or leased to companies for staff or delivery fleets.

values.label: Public contract
values.description: Won through a city tender. Paris bike-share and e-bike contracts.

values.label: Subsidy-dependent
values.description: Relies on bonus écologique, purchase aids, or other public funding to make the unit economics work.

axes.label: Regulation posture
axes.description: How the innovation relates to the existing rule set — a genuinely discriminating dimension in this space.

values.label: Enabled
values.description: Exists because the rules allow it. The L6e quadricycle category is the textbook case.

values.label: Neutral
values.description: Largely unaffected by the regulatory frame either way.

values.label: Challenging
values.description: Pushes against existing rules, often deployed before they catch up. Early dockless scooters.

values.label: Shaping
values.description: Actively lobbying for or co-designing new categories and frameworks. Mobilians, city pilots, industry associations.

values.label: Killed
values.description: Shut down or made unviable by a regulatory decision. Paris rental scooter ban is the canonical example.
